MARWA CHOSES YOU!

Experience the Marwa signature with greater depth in Arabiyat Prestige Marwa Extrait de Parfum. Created for men and women, this 60 ml fragrance reveals a richer, smoother and more enveloping interpretation of Marwa, pairing a vibrant opening with a warm, sensual foundation.
